problem.passage:
Art historians examining the workshop practices of Renaissance-era painters have long questioned how much of a celebrated master's output was actually painted by the master himself rather than by assistants working under his supervision. One view holds that attribution to a given master should be based primarily on stylistic consistency—that is, a painting should be credited to the master if its brushwork, color palette, and composition closely match the master's known solo works, regardless of who physically applied the paint, since the master's design and final approval were what defined the work as "his." A competing view holds that true authorship requires evidence of the master's own hand in the actual execution, not merely his design or supervision, so a painting produced largely by assistants should not be attributed to the master even if it closely resembles his style. Conservators examining underdrawings and pigment layers of several paintings long attributed to a well-known Florentine workshop found that in works where the underlying sketch showed the confident, fluid lines characteristic of the master's documented solo drawings, the final paint layers also showed brushstroke patterns matching his known technique. By contrast, in paintings where the underdrawing showed the more tentative, corrected lines typical of apprentice practice, the final paint layers showed brushwork inconsistent with the master's documented technique, even though the overall composition and color choices closely followed his typical designs.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the view that authorship should be based on evidence of the master's own hand in execution rather than on stylistic consistency alone?
problem.stimulus: Art historians examining the workshop practices of Renaissance-era painters have long questioned how much of a celebrated master's output was actually painted by the master himself rather than by assistants working under his supervision. One view holds that attribution to a given master should be based primarily on stylistic consistency—that is, a painting should be credited to the master if its brushwork, color palette, and composition closely match the master's known solo works, regardless of who physically applied the paint, since the master's design and final approval were what defined the work as "his." A competing view holds that true authorship requires evidence of the master's own hand in the actual execution, not merely his design or supervision, so a painting produced largely by assistants should not be attributed to the master even if it closely resembles his style. Conservators examining underdrawings and pigment layers of several paintings long attributed to a well-known Florentine workshop found that in works where the underlying sketch showed the confident, fluid lines characteristic of the master's documented solo drawings, the final paint layers also showed brushstroke patterns matching his known technique. By contrast, in paintings where the underdrawing showed the more tentative, corrected lines typical of apprentice practice, the final paint layers showed brushwork inconsistent with the master's documented technique, even though the overall composition and color choices closely followed his typical designs.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the view that authorship should be based on evidence of the master's own hand in execution rather than on stylistic consistency alone?
options: Paintings with tentative, apprentice-style underdrawings nonetheless had final brushwork that closely matched the master's documented technique.
Paintings with confident, master-style underdrawings had final paint layers whose brushwork did not match the master's documented technique.
Paintings whose underdrawings showed apprentice-style lines had final brushwork inconsistent with the master's technique, despite following his typical compositions and color choices.
The overall composition and color palette of several paintings closely matched the master's known solo works regardless of who executed the underdrawing.
problem.explanation: 정답 C는 밑그림이 도제 방식임에도 불구하고 최종 붓질이 스승의 기법과 일치하지 않았다는 점, 그리고 구도와 색채는 여전히 스승의 전형적 양식을 따랐다는 점을 함께 제시한다. 이는 구도·색채라는 '양식적 일관성'만으로는 실제로 스승이 그렸는지 알 수 없으며, 붓질이라는 '집행 증거'가 따로 필요하다는 집행파 견해를 정확히 뒷받침한다. A는 도제 밑그림인데 붓질이 스승과 일치한다는, 지문에 없는 반대 방향의 조합으로 오히려 양식파(구도·색채 일치로 충분)를 지지하는 것처럼 보일 수 있는 함정이다. B는 스승 밑그림인데 붓질이 불일치한다는 지문에 없는 조합으로, 밑그림-붓질 상관관계 자체를 흔들어 집행파 기준의 신뢰성을 약화시키는 사례이지 지지하는 사례가 아니다. D는 구도·색채가 일치한다는 사실만 제시하고 붓질(집행 증거)을 언급하지 않으므로, 오히려 '양식적 일관성으로 충분하다'는 반대 견해를 뒷받침한다.
problem.explanationEn: Choice C reports that even though the underdrawing was apprentice-style, the final brushwork still didn't match the master's technique, while the composition and color choices still followed his typical designs. This directly supports the 'execution' view: stylistic consistency (composition, color) alone isn't enough to prove authorship—separate evidence of the master's own hand (brushwork) is needed. A describes an apprentice underdrawing paired with matching brushwork, a combination not found in the passage that would actually support the stylistic-consistency view instead. B describes a master underdrawing paired with mismatched brushwork, also not in the passage, and would undermine rather than support the execution-based criterion by showing the underdrawing-brushwork correlation isn't reliable. D only reports that composition and color matched, saying nothing about brushwork/execution evidence, so it actually supports the opposing stylistic-consistency view.

key_relations: 밑그림 유형(스승/도제)과 최종 붓질 기법 일치 여부의 상관관계
구도·색채(양식)와 붓질(집행)이 서로 별개로 판단될 수 있다는 구분
실제 집행 증거파(붓질 불일치)가 양식적 일관성(구도 일치)을 압도해야 함
design.answer_uses_relations: 정답은 도제 밑그림+붓질 불일치라는 집행 증거와, 그럼에도 구도·색채는 스승 양식과 일치한다는 점을 동시에 제시해 '양식만으로는 부족하고 집행 증거가 핵심'이라는 주장을 정확히 뒷받침한다.

distractor_design.relation: 붓질과 스승 기법의 일치라는 요소를 다루지만 방향이 반대(집행파 주장과 모순)
밑그림-붓질 상관관계의 일부(스승 밑그림에서도 불일치 가능)를 다루지만 지문에 없는 조합이며 오히려 집행파 기준의 신뢰성을 약화시키는 사례
양식적 일관성(구도·색채)만 다루고 집행 증거(붓질)를 배제해 오히려 양식파를 뒷받침

design.target_difficulty_note: 정답과 오답 C(선택지 D)는 모두 '구도·색채가 스승과 일치'라는 동일한 사실을 언급하지만, 정답은 여기에 '붓질 불일치'라는 집행 증거를 추가로 결합해야 하고, 오답은 그 결합 없이 양식적 요소만 남겨 반대 입장을 지지하게 된다는 점에서 정교한 구분이 필요하다.

problem.evidenceTarget: Authorship of a painting should be determined by evidence of the master's own hand in the execution (e.g., brushwork), not merely by stylistic consistency in design and composition.
problem.evidenceSpan: in paintings where the underdrawing showed the more tentative, corrected lines typical of apprentice practice, the final paint layers showed brushwork inconsistent with the master's documented technique, even though the overall composition and color choices closely followed his typical designs
problem.answerRationale: 정답은 밑그림이 도제 방식임에도 최종 붓질이 스승의 기법과 불일치한다는 점, 그리고 구도·색채는 스승 양식과 일치한다는 점을 함께 제시하여, 양식적 일관성(구도·색채)만으로는 판단할 수 없고 실제 집행(붓질)의 증거가 별도로 필요함을 보여준다.

difficultyReasons: 정답을 고르려면 밑그림 유형, 붓질 일치 여부, 구도·색채 일치라는 세 가지 변수를 동시에 종합해야 함(3단계 이상 추론)
양식적 일관성(구도·색채)과 집행 증거(붓질)라는 두 축을 정확히 구분해야 하며, 오답들이 이 두 축을 부분적으로만 다루거나 방향을 뒤바꿔 제시해 혼동을 유발함
A와 C는 '붓질 불일치'라는 핵심 정보를 공유하지만 인과 방향이 정반대라 세심한 논리적 판단이 필요함
D는 지문 문장과 표면적으로 매우 유사해 보여 꼼꼼히 논지와 대조하지 않으면 정답으로 오인하기 쉬움

distractors.plausibleBecause: 밑그림-붓질 관계를 다루고 있어 관련 있어 보이지만, 실제로는 집행파 주장과 반대 방향의 결과를 제시한다
distractors.matches: 밑그림 유형과 붓질 기법의 상관관계라는 지문의 핵심 변수를 다룸
distractors.whyWrong: 이 결과는 오히려 양식(붓질 기법)이 밑그림의 숙련도와 무관하게 스승 것과 일치할 수 있음을 보여주어, 집행 증거보다는 양식적 일관성을 뒷받침하거나 두 기준이 별 차이 없다는 방향으로 흐른다. 집행파의 핵심 주장(집행 증거가 양식 일치를 압도해야 한다)을 지지하지 않는다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 스승 밑그림과 붓질 불일치라는, 지문에 나오지 않은 새로운 조합을 제시해 그럴듯해 보인다
distractors.matches: 밑그림-붓질 상관관계라는 주제와 붓질 불일치라는 요소를 부분적으로 공유
distractors.whyWrong: 지문에 실제로 보고된 바 없는 가상의 조합이며, 이는 오히려 밑그림 유형과 붓질 기법 사이의 상관관계 자체를 약화시켜 집행파가 사용하려는 근거(밑그림-붓질 일치 패턴)의 신뢰성을 훼손한다. 즉 질문이 요구하는 '집행 증거 우선' 주장을 직접 지지하지 않는다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 지문에서 여러 작품의 구도와 색채가 스승 양식과 일치했다는 서술과 표면적으로 일치해 보인다
distractors.matches: 구도·색채가 스승 전형 디자인과 일치한다는 지문 서술과 일치
distractors.whyWrong: 이 선택지는 집행(붓질) 증거를 완전히 배제하고 양식적 요소(구도·색채)만 언급하므로, 오히려 '양식적 일관성이면 충분하다'는 반대 견해를 뒷받침한다. 집행파의 핵심 주장인 '집행 증거가 있어야 한다'는 논리와는 무관하거나 반대 방향이다

problem.passage:
Marine biologists have long debated why some deep-sea octopus species brood their eggs for periods lasting several years, far longer than most other cephalopods. One hypothesis holds that the extreme cold of the deep ocean simply slows metabolic processes, including embryonic development, so that long brooding is an unavoidable consequence of low temperature rather than an adaptive strategy in itself. A competing hypothesis argues that extended brooding is favored by natural selection because it allows embryos to develop into larger, more independent hatchlings that are better able to survive in the food-scarce deep sea, and that the cold environment is merely a permissive condition, not the cause, of the long brooding period. Researchers studying a population of Graneledone boreopacifica off the coast of California recorded a brooding period of nearly four and a half years, the longest yet observed in any animal. To distinguish between the two hypotheses, researchers have pointed out that if temperature alone explained brooding duration, then species living at similarly cold depths should show roughly the same brooding times regardless of hatchling size, since all embryos would be equally slowed by the cold. However, if extended brooding is instead an adaptation for producing well-developed young, then among species living at comparable depths and temperatures, those that hatch larger, more developed young should brood for consistently longer periods, even when temperature is held constant across comparisons.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the hypothesis that extended brooding is an adaptation for producing well-developed hatchlings rather than simply a byproduct of cold temperatures?
problem.stimulus: Marine biologists have long debated why some deep-sea octopus species brood their eggs for periods lasting several years, far longer than most other cephalopods. One hypothesis holds that the extreme cold of the deep ocean simply slows metabolic processes, including embryonic development, so that long brooding is an unavoidable consequence of low temperature rather than an adaptive strategy in itself. A competing hypothesis argues that extended brooding is favored by natural selection because it allows embryos to develop into larger, more independent hatchlings that are better able to survive in the food-scarce deep sea, and that the cold environment is merely a permissive condition, not the cause, of the long brooding period. Researchers studying a population of Graneledone boreopacifica off the coast of California recorded a brooding period of nearly four and a half years, the longest yet observed in any animal. To distinguish between the two hypotheses, researchers have pointed out that if temperature alone explained brooding duration, then species living at similarly cold depths should show roughly the same brooding times regardless of hatchling size, since all embryos would be equally slowed by the cold. However, if extended brooding is instead an adaptation for producing well-developed young, then among species living at comparable depths and temperatures, those that hatch larger, more developed young should brood for consistently longer periods, even when temperature is held constant across comparisons.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the hypothesis that extended brooding is an adaptation for producing well-developed hatchlings rather than simply a byproduct of cold temperatures?
options: Among several octopus species living at the same depth and temperature, the species producing the largest, most independent hatchlings consistently had the longest brooding periods.
Graneledone boreopacifica embryos developed more slowly than embryos of shallow-water octopus species kept in the same cold laboratory tank.
Brooding octopuses in the deep sea were observed guarding their eggs continuously and rarely leaving the nest site to feed.
Octopus species living at shallower, warmer depths generally had shorter brooding periods than species living in the deep sea.
problem.explanation: 정답 A는 온도(깊이)가 동일한 여러 종을 비교했을 때 더 크고 독립적인 새끼를 낳는 종일수록 포란 기간이 길었다는 결과로, 지문이 명시한 '온도가 일정하게 통제된 상태에서 부화체 크기와 포란 기간이 함께 증가해야 적응 가설이 지지된다'는 조건을 정확히 충족한다. B는 온도가 발달 속도를 늦춘다는 사실만 보여줄 뿐 부화체 크기와의 관계를 다루지 않아 온도 가설도 동일하게 설명 가능하다. C는 포란 행동의 존재만 보여줄 뿐 기간의 길이나 원인과는 무관하다. D는 깊이와 포란 기간의 상관관계를 보여주지만 온도를 통제하지 않았으므로 온도 가설로도 똑같이 설명될 수 있어 두 가설을 구분하지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: Choice A shows that among species at the same depth/temperature, those producing larger, more independent hatchlings consistently brooded longer—exactly the temperature-controlled comparison the passage says would support the adaptive hypothesis. B only shows that cold slows development, which the temperature hypothesis already predicts, without addressing hatchling size. C shows brooding behavior exists but says nothing about duration or its cause. D shows a depth-duration correlation but doesn't control for temperature, so it's equally consistent with the temperature-only hypothesis and fails to distinguish between the two.

key_relations: 온도가 같을 때(조건 통제) 포란 기간과 부화체 크기의 관계
온도 가설: 온도만으로 포란 기간이 결정되면 깊이가 같으면 기간도 비슷해야 함
적응 가설: 온도를 통제해도 크기가 클수록 기간이 길어야 함
design.answer_uses_relations: 정답은 온도(깊이)가 동일한 여러 종을 비교하여 부화체 크기와 포란 기간이 함께 증가하는 패턴을 보여줌으로써, 온도 하나만으로는 설명되지 않는 추가 변수(적응적 선택)의 존재를 입증한다.

distractor_design.relation: 온도가 낮을수록 발달이 느려진다는 사실 자체
포란 행동의 존재를 보여주지만 기간의 원인 비교가 아님
깊이와 기간의 상관관계이지만 온도를 통제하지 않아 온도 가설도 동일하게 설명 가능

design.target_difficulty_note: 온도 통제 여부와 크기-기간 상관관계를 동시에 확인해야 하며, 오답들은 온도 가설과 적응 가설 모두에 부합하는 정보(깊이-기간 상관 등)를 제시해 변별력을 요구한다.

problem.evidenceTarget: Extended brooding in deep-sea octopuses is an adaptation for producing larger, more developed hatchlings, not merely a passive effect of cold temperature.
problem.evidenceSpan: those that hatch larger, more developed young should brood for consistently longer periods, even when temperature is held constant across comparisons
problem.answerRationale: 정답은 '깊이·온도가 같은 조건'에서 '더 크고 발달한 새끼를 낳는 종일수록 포란 기간이 길다'는 두 조건을 동시에 만족시켜, 온도 변수를 통제한 채 부화체 크기와 포란 기간의 관계만 보여준다.

difficultyReasons: 온도를 통제한 비교와 통제하지 않은 비교를 구분해야 하는 조건적 추론이 필요함
두 경쟁 가설(온도 대 적응)의 예측을 정확히 구분해서 적용해야 함
D와 정답 A는 표면적으로 비슷한 상관관계를 보여주지만 통제 변수 유무라는 미묘한 차이로 구분되어야 함
여러 문장에 흩어진 가설 설명을 종합해서 논리적으로 재구성해야 함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 온도가 낮을수록 발달이 느려진다는 것은 지문의 온도 가설과 직접 관련되어 보이므로 관련성이 있어 보인다.
distractors.matches: 지문의 '극한의 저온이 대사 과정을 늦춘다'는 온도 가설 서술과 일치한다.
distractors.whyWrong: 이 발견은 온도가 발달 속도에 영향을 준다는 것만 보여줄 뿐, 온도를 통제했을 때 부화체 크기와 포란 기간의 관계를 보여주지 않으므로 두 가설을 구분하지 못하고 오히려 온도 가설을 지지하는 것처럼 보인다.

distractors.plausibleBecause: 포란 행동에 대한 구체적 관찰이라 관련 정보처럼 보인다.
distractors.matches: 지문에서 포란(brooding) 행동 자체를 언급하고 있어 관련된 것처럼 보인다.
distractors.whyWrong: 포란 중 계속 알을 지킨다는 사실은 포란 기간의 길이나 그 원인(온도 대 적응)과 무관하며, 두 가설 중 어느 것도 지지하거나 반박하지 않는다.

distractors.plausibleBecause: 깊이와 온도, 포란 기간의 관계를 다루고 있어 지문의 핵심 주제와 관련되어 보인다.
distractors.matches: 지문에서 깊은 바다의 저온이 포란 기간과 연관된다는 논의와 표면적으로 일치한다.
distractors.whyWrong: 이 발견은 온도가 통제되지 않은 비교이므로, 온도 자체가 기간을 결정한다는 온도 가설로도 똑같이 설명 가능하다. 즉 온도와 적응 가설을 구분하지 못하는 증거이다.

problem.passage:
A team of botanists studying carnivorous pitcher plants in Southeast Asian peat swamps proposed that the plants' pitcher-shaped leaves evolved primarily to trap and digest insects for nitrogen, rather than to store rainwater as a defense against seasonal drought, an alternative explanation that had been proposed decades earlier. To test the nitrogen-capture hypothesis, researchers fed pitcher plants insects labeled with a rare nitrogen isotope and then measured isotope levels throughout the plant's tissues over several weeks. They found that leaves distant from the pitchers themselves showed significantly elevated levels of the labeled isotope within ten days, indicating that nitrogen from digested insects had been transported and incorporated into new plant growth across the organism.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the botanists' claim that pitcher-shaped leaves evolved primarily to capture insect nitrogen rather than to store rainwater?
problem.stimulus: A team of botanists studying carnivorous pitcher plants in Southeast Asian peat swamps proposed that the plants' pitcher-shaped leaves evolved primarily to trap and digest insects for nitrogen, rather than to store rainwater as a defense against seasonal drought, an alternative explanation that had been proposed decades earlier. To test the nitrogen-capture hypothesis, researchers fed pitcher plants insects labeled with a rare nitrogen isotope and then measured isotope levels throughout the plant's tissues over several weeks. They found that leaves distant from the pitchers themselves showed significantly elevated levels of the labeled isotope within ten days, indicating that nitrogen from digested insects had been transported and incorporated into new plant growth across the organism.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the botanists' claim that pitcher-shaped leaves evolved primarily to capture insect nitrogen rather than to store rainwater?
options: Pitcher plants grow most abundantly in peat swamps that receive heavy seasonal rainfall.
The labeled nitrogen isotope from digested insects appeared at elevated levels in leaves far from the pitchers within ten days.
The pitcher-shaped leaves are lined with a slippery surface that causes insects to fall into the digestive fluid below.
Pitcher plants that received no insect prey for several weeks still maintained normal water levels in their pitcher-shaped leaves.
problem.explanation: 식물학자들의 주장은 잎사귀 모양이 곤충 포획을 통한 질소 획득을 위해 진화했다는 인과관계다. B는 곤충에서 유래한 표지 질소가 실제로 식물 전체로 퍼져 새로운 성장에 쓰였다는 직접적 결과이므로 이 인과관계를 가장 잘 뒷받침한다. A는 강우량이 많은 곳에서 잘 자란다는 상관관계만 보여줄 뿐, 이는 오히려 빗물 저장 가설과도 부합할 수 있어 주장과 무관하거나 반대 해석의 여지가 있다. C는 포충 구조가 곤충을 붙잡는 물리적 메커니즘만 설명할 뿐, 그렇게 잡힌 곤충의 질소가 실제로 흡수되어 식물 전체로 이동했는지는 보여주지 않으므로 주장의 일부만 뒷받침한다. D는 곤충 없이도 잎이 정상적인 수분 저장 기능을 유지한다는 것으로, 이는 빗물 저장 가설을 직접 반박하는 방향이 아니라 오히려 저수 기능이 곤충 섭식과 무관하게 작동함을 보여주어 질소 포획이 '주된' 진화 목적이라는 주장과는 별개의 논점이다.
problem.evidenceTarget: pitcher-shaped leaves evolved primarily to trap and digest insects for nitrogen, rather than to store rainwater
problem.evidenceSpan: leaves distant from the pitchers themselves showed significantly elevated levels of the labeled isotope within ten days, indicating that nitrogen from digested insects had been transported and incorporated into new plant growth across the organism
problem.answerRationale: 표지 질소 동위원소가 포충엽에서 멀리 떨어진 잎까지 퍼져 새로운 성장 조직에 편입되었다는 것은, 곤충에서 유래한 질소가 실제로 식물 전체의 성장에 사용되었다는 직접적 인과적 증거이며, 이는 잎 모양의 진화적 목적이 빗물 저장이 아니라 질소 포획에 있다는 주장을 가장 강하게 뒷받침한다.

distractors.matches: 지문의 '계절적 가뭄에 대한 방어로 빗물을 저장'이라는 대안 가설의 배경 언급과 표면적으로 연결됨

problem.passage: Urban planners in several mid-sized cities have debated whether converting downtown car lanes into dedicated bus rapid transit (BRT) corridors reduces overall commute times or merely shifts congestion elsewhere. Proponents argue that BRT corridors, by giving buses their own lane free of car traffic, allow more passengers to move through a corridor per hour than mixed traffic would. Critics counter that removing a car lane simply pushes drivers onto adjacent streets, worsening travel times for those who continue to drive. A transportation agency conducted a two-year study of one city's new BRT corridor, comparing average commute times for bus riders, drivers on the corridor itself, and drivers on three parallel side streets before and after conversion.
problem.stimulus: Urban planners in several mid-sized cities have debated whether converting downtown car lanes into dedicated bus rapid transit (BRT) corridors reduces overall commute times or merely shifts congestion elsewhere. Critics counter that removing a car lane simply pushes drivers onto adjacent streets, worsening travel times for those who continue to drive. A transportation agency conducted a two-year study of one city's new BRT corridor, comparing average commute times for bus riders, drivers on the corridor itself, and drivers on three parallel side streets before and after conversion.
problem.question: Which quotation from the transportation agency's study would most effectively illustrate the claim that BRT corridors improve overall commute times without significantly worsening conditions for drivers?
options: Bus ridership along the corridor increased by 34 percent in the year following the lane conversion.
Average bus commute times fell by 22 percent, while average drive times on the three parallel side streets rose by less than 3 percent.
The agency surveyed 1,200 residents about their satisfaction with public transit services citywide.

problem.explanation: 지문에서 연구는 버스 탑승자의 통근 시간과 인접 도로 운전자의 통근 시간을 함께 비교했다고 밝힌다. 주장은 'BRT가 전체 통근 시간을 개선하면서도 운전자에게 큰 악영향을 주지 않는다'는 것이므로, 정답은 버스 시간 대폭 단축과 인근 도로 시간의 미미한 증가를 동시에 보여줘야 한다. B가 이 두 조건을 모두 충족한다. A는 탑승객 증가만 보여줄 뿐 통근 시간 비교가 아니다. C는 설문 만족도로 통근 시간과 무관하다. D는 코리더 자체의 교통량 감소만 언급하며 인근 도로 운전자에게 미친 영향을 보여주지 않아 주장의 절반만 뒷받침한다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage states the study compared commute times for bus riders and drivers on parallel streets together. The claim requires showing both improved bus times AND minimal harm to drivers, so the answer must cover both halves. Choice B does this. Choice A only shows increased ridership, not commute time comparison. Choice C is about satisfaction surveys, unrelated to commute times. Choice D only addresses traffic on the corridor itself, not the side-street drivers' outcomes, so it supports only part of the claim.
problem.evidenceTarget: BRT corridors improve overall commute times without significantly worsening conditions for drivers.
problem.evidenceSpan: comparing average commute times for bus riders, drivers on the corridor itself, and drivers on three parallel side streets before and after conversion
problem.answerRationale: Because the study specifically compared bus riders and drivers on parallel side streets, the finding must address both groups; only the choice reporting large bus-time gains alongside a negligible increase on side streets covers both halves of the comparison the claim requires.

difficultyReasons: 질문이 요구하는 두 가지 요소(버스 통근시간 개선 + 운전자 악화 없음)를 모두 충족하는 선택지를 찾아야 함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 버스 승차율 증가는 BRT의 성공을 보여주는 긍정적 지표처럼 보인다

distractors.whyWrong: 통근 시간 개선이나 운전자에게 미치는 영향에 대한 정보가 없어 질문의 핵심 주장(전체 통근시간 개선 + 운전자에 대한 악영향 없음)을 뒷받침하지 못함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 기관이 실시한 조사라는 점에서 신뢰할 만한 자료처럼 보임

problem.passage:
An art historian studying the workshop practices of the 17th-century Dutch painter Judith Leyster argued that Leyster trained and directly supervised at least three apprentices during her most productive years, contrary to earlier accounts that described her as working in relative isolation. The historian's evidence came from newly examined guild registration records and a technical analysis of pigment layers in several paintings previously attributed solely to Leyster. The guild records listed three named apprentices registered under Leyster's household between 1633 and 1635. Additionally, infrared imaging of two paintings revealed underdrawings executed in a hand distinct from Leyster's own, later overpainted in a style consistent with her signature technique, suggesting a collaborative production process typical of workshops with active apprentices. The historian also noted that Leyster herself had registered with the local painters' guild in 1633, several years before she produced her most acclaimed works, a fact that establishes her professional standing but says nothing about whether she later directed assistants.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the historian's claim that Leyster trained and supervised apprentices rather than working in isolation?
problem.stimulus: An art historian studying the workshop practices of the 17th-century Dutch painter Judith Leyster argued that Leyster trained and directly supervised at least three apprentices during her most productive years, contrary to earlier accounts that described her as working in relative isolation. The historian's evidence came from newly examined guild registration records and a technical analysis of pigment layers in several paintings previously attributed solely to Leyster. The guild records listed three named apprentices registered under Leyster's household between 1633 and 1635. Additionally, infrared imaging of two paintings revealed underdrawings executed in a hand distinct from Leyster's own, later overpainted in a style consistent with her signature technique, suggesting a collaborative production process typical of workshops with active apprentices. The historian also noted that Leyster herself had registered with the local painters' guild in 1633, several years before she produced her most acclaimed works, a fact that establishes her professional standing but says nothing about whether she later directed assistants.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the historian's claim that Leyster trained and supervised apprentices rather than working in isolation?
options: Infrared imaging revealed underdrawings in a hand distinct from Leyster's own that were later overpainted in her signature style.
Leyster registered with the local painters' guild in 1633, several years before she produced her most acclaimed works.
The guild records that listed the three apprentices did not specify the ages or prior training of those individuals.

problem.explanation: 역사가의 주장은 레이스터르가 도제들과 '협업'하며 작업을 감독했다는 것이다. 정답은 다른 사람의 손으로 그려진 밑그림이 그녀의 기법으로 덧칠된 물리적 증거를 제시하므로 협업·감독 관계를 직접 뒷받침한다. 나머지 선택지는 길드 등록 시점, 기록의 세부사항 누락, 상반된 이전 견해 등만 언급할 뿐 감독 관계를 직접 입증하지 못한다.
problem.evidenceTarget: Leyster trained and directly supervised at least three apprentices rather than working in relative isolation.
problem.evidenceSpan: infrared imaging of two paintings revealed underdrawings executed in a hand distinct from Leyster's own, later overpainted in a style consistent with her signature technique, suggesting a collaborative production process typical of workshops with active apprentices
problem.answerRationale: 서로 다른 손이 그린 밑그림 위에 레이스터르 특유의 기법으로 덧칠된 물리적 흔적은 작업이 도제와의 협업 과정을 거쳤음을 보여주므로, 그녀가 고립되어 작업했다는 기존 설명과 달리 도제를 지도·감독했다는 주장을 직접 뒷받침한다.

problem.passage:
Urban historians studying nineteenth-century streetcar systems have argued that the introduction of electric trolleys, rather than population growth alone, reshaped the physical layout of American cities. Before electrification, horse-drawn streetcars were slow and limited in range, which kept most residents clustered within walking distance of city centers. When electric trolleys began operating in the 1890s, average travel speeds nearly tripled, allowing workers to live much farther from their jobs. City directories from Cleveland show that between 1888 and 1902, new residential construction increased more than fivefold in outlying districts served by trolley lines, while construction in the urban core remained relatively flat. Historians point out that these outlying districts had not previously been considered viable for residential development because of the long commute times involved. Some scholars caution that rising incomes during this period may also have allowed families to afford homes farther from work, independent of transit improvements.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the historians' claim that electric trolleys, rather than income growth, drove the shift toward outlying residential development?
problem.stimulus: Urban historians studying nineteenth-century streetcar systems have argued that the introduction of electric trolleys, rather than population growth alone, reshaped the physical layout of American cities. Before electrification, horse-drawn streetcars were slow and limited in range, which kept most residents clustered within walking distance of city centers. When electric trolleys began operating in the 1890s, average travel speeds nearly tripled, allowing workers to live much farther from their jobs. City directories from Cleveland show that between 1888 and 1902, new residential construction increased more than fivefold in outlying districts served by trolley lines, while construction in the urban core remained relatively flat. Historians point out that these outlying districts had not previously been considered viable for residential development because of the long commute times involved. Some scholars caution that rising incomes during this period may also have allowed families to afford homes farther from work, independent of transit improvements.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the historians' claim that electric trolleys, rather than income growth, drove the shift toward outlying residential development?
options: Residential construction in outlying trolley districts rose sharply only in the years immediately following trolley line openings, even in neighborhoods where average household income had not yet increased.
City directories from Cleveland recorded a fivefold increase in residential construction in districts served by trolley lines between 1888 and 1902.
Average travel speeds on electric trolleys were nearly three times faster than those of the horse-drawn streetcars they replaced.
Outlying districts had previously been considered unsuitable for residential development because of long commute times on foot or by horse-drawn car.
problem.explanation: 질문은 '소득 증가가 아니라 전차가 교외 주거 개발을 이끌었다'는 주장을 가장 직접적으로 뒷받침하는 새로운 발견을 찾는 것이다. 지문은 소득 증가도 대안 설명이 될 수 있다고 언급했으므로, 이 대안을 배제하는 증거가 필요하다. 정답 A는 가구 소득이 아직 오르지 않은 지역에서도 전차 노선 개통 직후 건설이 급증했다는 것을 보여주어, 소득이 아닌 전차 접근성이 원인임을 직접적으로 입증한다. B는 지문에 이미 나온 사실(클리블랜드 건설 증가)을 반복할 뿐 소득 변수를 배제하지는 못한다. C는 전차의 속도 증가만 보여줄 뿐 그것이 소득 증가보다 우선한 원인이라는 것을 입증하지 않는다. D는 교외 지역이 예전에 개발 부적합지로 여겨졌다는 배경 정보일 뿐, 소득과 전차 중 무엇이 원인인지에 대한 답은 아니다. 따라서 정답은 A번이다.
problem.evidenceTarget: 전차 도입이 소득 증가와 무관하게 교외 주거 개발을 이끌었다는 역사학자들의 주장
problem.evidenceSpan: Some scholars caution that rising incomes during this period may also have allowed families to afford homes farther from work, independent of transit improvements.
problem.answerRationale: 지문이 소득 증가라는 대안 설명 가능성을 제기했으므로, 소득이 오르지 않은 지역에서도 전차 개통 직후 건설이 급증했다는 사실은 소득 변수를 통제하면서 전차의 인과적 역할을 직접 입증한다.

problem.passage: Art historians have generally attributed the widespread adoption of linear perspective in fifteenth-century Florentine painting to Filippo Brunelleschi's architectural experiments, which demonstrated how parallel lines could be made to converge toward a single vanishing point on the horizon. Some scholars, however, argue that the technique spread not because artists grasped its mathematical logic but because patrons increasingly demanded paintings that matched the visual conventions already popularized in a few celebrated commissions. To adjudicate between these explanations, a historian examined contracts and correspondence between painters and their patrons from the period, looking specifically for evidence of whether patrons explicitly requested perspective techniques or whether painters introduced them independently.
problem.stimulus: Art historians have generally attributed the widespread adoption of linear perspective in fifteenth-century Florentine painting to Filippo Brunelleschi's architectural experiments, which demonstrated how parallel lines could be made to converge toward a single vanishing point on the horizon. Some scholars, however, argue that the technique spread not because artists grasped its mathematical logic but because patrons increasingly demanded paintings that matched the visual conventions already popularized in a few celebrated commissions. To adjudicate between these explanations, a historian examined contracts and correspondence between painters and their patrons from the period, looking specifically for evidence of whether patrons explicitly requested perspective techniques or whether painters introduced them independently.
problem.question: Which finding from the historian's research would most directly support the claim that patron demand, rather than artists' independent understanding, drove the spread of linear perspective?
options: Painters who had trained under Brunelleschi's direct associates were more likely to use precise vanishing points in their compositions.
Contracts from the period show that patrons frequently referenced specific well-known paintings and asked for similar 'modern' spatial effects.
Correspondence reveals that patrons rarely discussed painting techniques at all, focusing instead on subject matter and cost.
Brunelleschi's original architectural drawings included detailed geometric proofs explaining the convergence of parallel lines.
problem.explanation: 지문은 역사가가 '후원자가 명시적으로 원근법을 요청했는지, 아니면 화가가 독자적으로 도입했는지'를 판별하려 했다고 밝힌다. 후원자 수요설을 뒷받침하려면 후원자가 실제로 특정 유명 작품을 언급하며 유사한 효과를 요구했다는 증거가 필요하다. B가 정확히 이를 보여준다. A는 브루넬레스키 계열 화가들의 기술 습득을 보여줄 뿐 후원자 요구와는 무관하며 오히려 예술가 이해설을 뒷받침한다. C는 후원자가 기법을 거의 논의하지 않았다는 내용으로 오히려 명시적 요청이 있었다는 주장과 모순된다. D는 브루넬레스키의 수학적 이해를 보여줄 뿐 후원자의 역할과 무관하다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage states the historian looked for evidence of whether patrons explicitly requested perspective or artists introduced it independently. To support the patron-demand theory, evidence must show patrons actively requesting effects seen in famous works — exactly what B shows. Choice A shows technical transmission among Brunelleschi's associates, which actually supports the artist-understanding explanation, not patron demand. Choice C shows patrons rarely discussed technique, which contradicts the claim of explicit requests. Choice D shows Brunelleschi's own mathematical understanding, irrelevant to the patron's role.
problem.evidenceTarget: Patron demand for fashionable visual conventions, rather than artists' independent mathematical understanding, explains the spread of linear perspective.
problem.evidenceSpan: looking specifically for evidence of whether patrons explicitly requested perspective techniques or whether painters introduced them independently
problem.answerRationale: Since the historian's search was framed as explicit patron requests versus independent artist introduction, only the finding showing patrons actively demanding effects seen in celebrated works directly supports the patron-demand explanation rather than the artist-understanding explanation.

problem.passage:
Marine ecologists have long debated why some coral reefs recover quickly after bleaching events while others do not. A research team studying reefs in the western Pacific proposed that microbial diversity in the surrounding water plays a key role in coral resilience. To test this, the team sampled water and coral tissue from twenty reef sites that had experienced similar thermal stress the previous year. They found that reefs with higher bacterial diversity in surrounding waters showed significantly faster regrowth of coral tissue over the following twelve months. The researchers also noted that sites near river mouths, which received more nutrient runoff, had lower bacterial diversity overall, though this pattern was not the focus of their central hypothesis. The team concluded that microbial diversity, rather than water temperature alone, may determine which reefs are able to bounce back after bleaching.

Which quotation from the passage most effectively illustrates the researchers' claim that microbial diversity influences coral recovery?

problem.explanation: 질문은 '미생물 다양성이 산호 회복에 영향을 미친다'는 주장을 가장 직접적으로 보여주는 인용문을 찾는 것이다. 정답 A는 세균 다양성이 높은 곳에서 재생 속도가 유의미하게 빨랐다는 구체적 상관관계를 제시해 주장을 정확히 뒷받침한다. B는 강 하구 지점의 세균 다양성이 낮다는 부가적 관찰로, 연구자들 스스로도 이는 핵심 가설의 초점이 아니라고 밝혔으므로 회복력과의 직접적 연결이 없다(일부만 관련된 오답). C는 연구 방법(표본 채취 절차)만 설명할 뿐 다양성과 회복 사이의 관계는 보여주지 않는다(무관한 인용). D는 애초에 연구가 설명하려는 현상(왜 어떤 산호초는 빨리 회복하고 어떤 것은 그렇지 않은가)을 제시할 뿐, 그 원인이 미생물 다양성이라는 주장 자체를 뒷받침하지는 않는다(질문에 대한 답이 아님). 따라서 정답은 A번이다.
problem.explanationEn: The question asks which quotation most directly illustrates the claim that microbial diversity affects coral recovery. Choice A directly links higher bacterial diversity to significantly faster tissue regrowth, making it the strongest support for the claim. Choice B describes a separate observation about river-mouth sites that the researchers explicitly said was not their central focus, so it only partially relates to the claim about recovery. Choice C merely describes the sampling method, showing no relationship between diversity and recovery. Choice D states the general phenomenon the study aims to explain but does not itself support the specific claim that microbial diversity is the cause. Therefore, the correct answer is A.

problem.passage:
Botanists studying desert wildflower blooms have investigated why some years produce spectacular "superblooms" while others yield only sparse flowering. One long-standing hypothesis holds that total winter rainfall is the primary trigger. Researchers tracking bloom intensity across the Mojave Desert over fifteen years found that years with the heaviest total rainfall did not always produce the most abundant blooms. Instead, the timing and spacing of rainfall events appeared to matter more: years with several moderate rain events spread across November through February produced denser blooms than years with a single heavy storm followed by long dry spells, even when total seasonal rainfall was similar. Seed bank samples taken from bloom sites showed that spaced rainfall allowed more dormant seeds to germinate successfully, while seeds exposed to a single soaking followed by drought often failed to establish roots before drying out. The botanists suggested that rainfall distribution, not just total quantity, determines bloom intensity.

Which quotation from the passage most effectively supports the researchers' conclusion that rainfall distribution, rather than total rainfall, determines bloom intensity?
problem.stimulus: Botanists studying desert wildflower blooms have investigated why some years produce spectacular "superblooms" while others yield only sparse flowering. One long-standing hypothesis holds that total winter rainfall is the primary trigger. Researchers tracking bloom intensity across the Mojave Desert over fifteen years found that years with the heaviest total rainfall did not always produce the most abundant blooms. Instead, the timing and spacing of rainfall events appeared to matter more: years with several moderate rain events spread across November through February produced denser blooms than years with a single heavy storm followed by long dry spells, even when total seasonal rainfall was similar. Seed bank samples taken from bloom sites showed that spaced rainfall allowed more dormant seeds to germinate successfully, while seeds exposed to a single soaking followed by drought often failed to establish roots before drying out. The botanists suggested that rainfall distribution, not just total quantity, determines bloom intensity.
problem.question: Which quotation from the passage most effectively supports the researchers' conclusion that rainfall distribution, rather than total rainfall, determines bloom intensity?
options: "years with several moderate rain events spread across November through February produced denser blooms than years with a single heavy storm followed by long dry spells, even when total seasonal rainfall was similar"
"years with the heaviest total rainfall did not always produce the most abundant blooms"
